recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It is a bounded current-build correction for the remaining obsolete element-name artifacts; no additional core source change is needed unless the Group diagram is regenerated by the build tooling later.
issue_request: FHIR-45508 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6. Although the original request asked whether Group.characteristic.duration[x] should stop being a Duration/Range choice, the final decision kept the duration model and required renaming Group.characteristic.timing to Group.characteristic.relativeTime plus adding notes/examples for duration, period, and relativeTime.
initial_application: HL7/fhir#3998 applied the issue through Jira-tagged Group commits, including moving inclusion/exclusion guidance into Group notes, updating Group element short/long descriptions, and renaming timing to relativeTime in the StructureDefinition and examples. The main source application was present, but source/fhir.ini [r5-r6-changes] and source/group/group.svg still exposed the obsolete timing element name.
additional_context: FHIR-I December 2025 minutes record the FHIR-45508 discussion, PR readiness, and 10-0-0 Persuasive with Modification vote. Group is active in source/fhir.ini [resources]. The already-published FHIR-50530 reconciliation adjusted later RelativeTime wording in Group notes, so this fix was limited to stale rename artifacts rather than reworking the Group semantics.
reconciliation: Changed source/fhir.ini so the active R5-to-R6 metadata lists Group.characteristic.relativeTime instead of the removed Group.characteristic.timing path, and changed source/group/group.svg so its element link/title/label also use relativeTime. Left duration[x] as Duration/Range and left the ballot note that intentionally mentions the old timing name to explain the rename.
